crew.overview: Tony Lip, a bouncer in 1962, is hired to drive pianist Don Shirley on a tour through the Deep South in the days when African Americans, forced to find alternate accommodations and services due to segregation laws below the Mason-Dixon Line, relied on a guide called The Negro Motorist Green Book.
crew.title: Green Book

details.biography: After the success of his debut solo album, “Citizen”, Artyom has been touring and performing live with diverse players — Everlast, Kamasi Washington, Melody Gardot, Daedalus, Flying Lotus, Peter Erskine, Hadrien Feraud, Charles Altura, MdCL, Tigran Hamasyan, Gretchen Parlato, Virgil Donati and many more
details.name: Artyom Manukyan
